verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting lets users ask open-ended natural-language questions like 'Why are customers requesting refunds?' to instantly analyze conversation data, and Suggestions automatically detects knowledge gaps and generates content drafts based on resolutions — both are clear AI-generated insight/suggestion features surfaced inside the product. Watchtower further applies natural-language-defined flagging criteria contextually across interactions, reinforcing the insight-generation theme. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these insight features' accuracy beyond vendor docs.
